name: ruslan_v2_1
description: Candidate: ruslan_v2 without SOL trades and without the 13-16 UTC session - BTC / ETH, entries 00:00-07:00 UTC
status: candidate, frozen - do not change parameters, otherwise the forward test is no longer a forward test; v2 (strategy_v2.json) keeps running unchanged next to it, both are computed from the same data
forward_note: written down at frozen_utc, a few minutes after the forward start, but nothing after data_used_until_utc had been downloaded; v2.1 has no entries at 20:00-24:00 UTC, so no window falls between the data used and the forward

base.sha256_canonical_definition: sha256 of json.dumps(json.load(file), sort_keys=True); ruslan_v2_1.py stops if strategy_v2.json no longer matches
base.rule: every parameter of v2 applies unless changed below, so the v2.1 trades are exactly the v2 trades on the coins and entry hours below

changes.trade_coins_detail: SOL is not traded. Its signals still count in max_coins_per_window (the coin_rule of v2 is unchanged): when SOL is one of the first two coins to trigger in a window, the third coin is still skipped
changes.utc_hours_detail: hour of the entry moment; = windows closing 00:15-07:00 UTC (28 of 96 windows a day per coin); the 13:00-16:00 session of v2 is dropped

selection.trigger: the v2 forward 01.10 19:00 - 14.10 20:00 UTC: 72 trades, win 83.3% at a breakeven of 82.1%, +1.2% per trade; SOL 8 trades -37.8%, 13-16 UTC 20 trades -10.7%
selection.before_the_v2_forward: in the v2 backtest 18.08-01.10 SOL alone (39 trades, +3.9%) and 13-16 UTC alone (61 trades, +3.9%) were not weak; weak were SOL at 00-07 UTC (24 trades, -6.0%) and BTC/ETH at 13-16 UTC (46 trades, -1.2%); all trades v2.1 drops: 85 trades +1.1% against +6.1% for the 144 it keeps
selection.pre_07_18_08: not used to choose v2 (separate archive, see ruslan_v2_pre.py), but seen when choosing v2.1: v2.1 55 trades +3.8%, the 14 dropped -7.0%
selection.in_sample: every trade before forward_start_utc, including the v2 forward and 07-18.08

forward_rules.stop_detail: on the first 100 v2.1 forward trades: win rate below 80% -> stop, there is no edge (at a true 88% this happens in 0.7% of cases, at 86% in 3.6%)
forward_rules.compare_with_v2: the v2 trades that v2.1 drops are reported on the same forward period: v2.1 is better than v2 only if they lose money there
forward_rules.timing: about 3.4 trades a day: 100 trades in about a month (mid-November 2026)
